name: Canvas-Wrapped Over-Ear Headphones
description: A pair of over-ear headphones with circular ear cups wrapped in oatmeal-beige cotton canvas, a headband whose outer face carries the same canvas and whose underside is lined with a band of natural cork, matte ecru-painted aluminium yoke arms and sliders, and memory-foam earpads covered in warm oatmeal woven textile.
materials: oatmeal-beige cotton canvas wrap on the ear cups and headband, natural cork headband lining, matte ecru-painted aluminium yoke arms and slider rails, memory-foam earpads in warm oatmeal woven textile
primaryColors: oatmeal canvas beige, natural cork tan, matte ecru aluminium
negativeConstraints: never render any text, logo, wordmark, engraving, or printing anywhere on the canvas, cork, yoke arms, or earpads; never render a third ear cup, controls on the left cup, a second status light, or a mismatched yoke finish, and never lose the single fine top-stitched seam encircling each cup; never render brushed copper, bronze, polished chrome, glossy plastic, or protein leather anywhere on this product, and never swap the canvas wrap or the cork lining for smooth painted composite Exception: a mark, wordmark, or label that the brief's art direction explicitly names is deliberate and must be rendered exactly as directed — the text bans above apply only to invented marks the art direction never asked for.
preservationNotes: the warm textile register of this product must hold in every frame: oatmeal-beige cotton canvas with a visible woven grain wrapping both circular ear cups and the outer face of the headband, one fine top-stitched seam encircling each cup, a band of natural cork with genuine cork granulation lining the headband underside, matte ecru-painted aluminium yoke arms and slider rails with no metallic sheen, oatmeal woven textile earpads, and exactly one small status light, two tactile buttons and one USB-C port on the lower edge of the right cup only, with the left cup entirely plain and unmarked, same cup diameter, headband arc and yoke geometry throughout When the art direction explicitly names a mark on this product, that named mark is part of the product's identity for that shot and overrides the blank-surface requirement.
